sloka: स तद्वचनमाज्ञाय राघवस्य विभीषणः ।तूर्णमुत्सारणे यत्नं कारयामास सर्वतः ।। ६.११७.१९ ।।
transliteration: sa tadvacanamājñāya rāghavasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।tūrṇamutsāraṇe yatnaṁ kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।। 6.117.19 ।।

translations.english: "O gentle Vibheeshana, let Sita who sought my victory always be quickly brought near me."
